judge.summary: The repository provides a complete, runnable budget‑tracking CLI. Core features—recording income/expense transactions, listing and deleting them, creating and funding savings goals, summarising totals and category breakdowns, and persisting data to a JSON file—are all implemented with clear code and basic input validation. No show‑stopper bugs or missing core functionality were found, so the submission meets the benchmark.
